description: Grouped PDF and Excel export from the Svelte 5 data grid. Group the grid by country or company through the header menu and export: the PDF and xlsx carry the grouping as bold group headers and per-cluster subtotal rows, taken from the grid's grouping state with no groupBy option needed. Print opens the zero-dependency Save as PDF view with a repeated header, a title and formatted values.

faq.question: Do I have to pass the grouping to the export?
faq.answer: No. exportData reads the grid's grouping state and writes group headers and subtotal rows for it; groupBy is only needed to export a grouping the grid is not showing.

faq.question: How are subtotals computed?
faq.answer: From the columns' aggregate settings, so the same sum or average the group row shows on screen appears in the subtotal row of the PDF and workbook.

faq.question: What is the difference between PDF export and Print?
faq.answer: PDF export writes the file directly with the grouping and formatting. Print renders a printable page and uses the browser's dialog, which needs no library and is what Save as PDF uses.
